_comment: Hand-written MCP config. If you are BUNDLING tvcontrol inside a desktop app, read docs/EMBEDDING.md instead: spawn process.execPath with an absolute path to src/server.js, never the tvcontrol bin by name.

tvcontrol-if-node-is-not-on-your-path._comment: Node installed via nvm, fnm, volta or asdf is not on a bare PATH, and a host that scrubs the environment will spawn with exit 127 and 'env: node: No such file or directory'. Use an absolute node path. Find yours with: command -v node
